''See also: [[Consultants Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Consultants are a highly efficient and globally widespread [[Guild]] known for providing expert advice, information, and strategic support to clients. They are widely regarded as the most loyal servants of [[The Empire|the Empire]], maintaining a reputation for absolute dedication to the Emperor and their professional contracts. While they are primarily known as advisors, they possess significant resources and can act as a formidable force in sabotage or combat when necessary. Despite rumors of them being assassins, the [[Guild]] officially does not employ hired killers, though they do engage in protecting clients by removing threats. [[The Guild]] is organized into several specialized orders. Shepherds focus on observation and scouting through rigorous training in infiltration and memory. [[Miners]] serve as archivists, maintaining the [[Guild]]'s vast and permanent records. [[Masons]] specialize in undercover work, while [[Gardeners]] are tasked with removing specific targets. The [[Council of Architects]] serves as the ruling body, consisting of diverse experts such as strategists, administrators, and [[Alchemists|alchemists]]. [[The Guild]] operates under a strict hierarchy of following orders and maintains its headquarters on the [[Gray Island]]. While they are masters of information manipulation and intelligence, they are generally considered less effective in direct, head-on military confrontations compared to other powers.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Consultants are a group, including [[Shera]], that can be hired for business assistance or advice but never work alone. Dressed in black outfits, these individuals maintain a presence on [[Gray Island]] and operate a comfortable prison where they perform thorough inspections of possessions. While they do not employ hired killers, they are enemies of [[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]] following a fight with her and may potentially kill [[Naberius Clayborn|Naberius]]. Though they prefer a world without an Emperor, they view anarchy as a haven for assassins and may operate under the influence of the [[Elders]]. During an encounter in an arena, three Consultants faced [[Calder]], who hoped they would kill one another alongside the [[Handmaiden]].}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Consultants are a group of two thousand individuals living on the [[Gray Island]], identified by their Gardening Shears crest and an order of assassins. This organization, which includes members such as [[Meia]] and [[Lucan]], maintains archives and possesses well-known knowledge of the entrance to [[Zhen of the Masons|Zhen]]’s [[House of the Masons]]. While [[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]] believes [[Shera]] can compete with them, the group has previously performed work on [[Ulrich Fletcher]]'s [[Workshop|workshop]] and was hired by local leaders to investigate disappearances. Despite their ability to win regardless of which side loses in conflicts, the group suffered heavy losses during a mission where only twenty-four of sixty-one members remained. Ultimately, the Consultants find themselves being forced to betray their cause through the use of the Emperor's crown.}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Recognized as [[The Empire|the Empire]]'s most dedicated servants, the Consultants are one of three [[Guilds]] that elect their leaders by bonding to a [[Vessel]]. This group, which includes the [[Gardeners]] and allies of the [[Luminian|Luminians]], maintains a presence on the island's terrain. While they stand to benefit from [[Loreli]] serving as [[Regent]], their true motives remain private, though they seek to hasten the Emperor toward his death. Although [[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]] trained [[Benji]] and others to emulate them, [[Lucan]] expresses a desire to push the group toward change. As they prepared for war, the Consultants suddenly vanished alongside [[Yala the High Mason|Yala]] and several former prisoners in red suits. Upon their return, they signaled their leadership by dropping to one knee and murmuring '[[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]]'.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|An exiled group that has nearly doubled in size over the last two years, the Consultants provide vital support by offering security from the shadows. Though they are not true killers, they utilize invested whistles to signal one another and can hear the cry of a winter-feather robin as if it were deafeningly loud. Following the Emperor's death, tens of thousands of people competed to hire them, leading the group to secure exits around the [[Rose Tower]] and act as a potential threat in the eyes of [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]]. During an ambush on [[Lucan]] and [[Shera]] involving Consultants hiding in crates, it became clear that [[Shera]] had not brought enough members to secure the location. Ultimately, as the group prepared to give up power by raising the [[Regents]], [[Shera]] faced the reality of their casualties and the need to apologize to her people.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Consultants]] are a group that [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] recognizes as a potential threat.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Consultants]] play a vital support role.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Two [[Consultants]] flowed through the ordinary [[Guild]] members like shadows.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Consultants]] have nearly doubled in size over the last two years.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Mistress of the Mists]] saw [[Shera]] as a potential [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]] for the [[Consultants]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Lucan]] prepared letters for a select few other [[Consultants]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Consultants]] would be giving up power by raising the [[Regents]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Consultants]] hid in crates to ambush [[Lucan]] and [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] had not brought enough [[Consultants]] to secure the place.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] wondered how many [[Consultants]] had died.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] would have to apologize to the [[Consultants]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“Yeah, I’d put that together too. Everybody wants me to take care of the other Guilds, like I can tell the Consultants how to do their jobs.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Upon induction into the Consultants, each Gardener was given a pair of “shears”<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|One by one, the Consultants dropped to a knee. “Guild Head,” they murmured. “Guild Head.”<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“You know, speaking of your death, I don’t see the Consultants around here.”<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|“We also need guarantees that your Guilds will continue to work together with ours. The Consultants and the alchemists especially play a vital support role, without which some of the other Guilds will cease to function.”<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}
